build_roberta_tensorizer_from_config: build a RoBERTaTensorizer instance from a Config object with vocab file and tokenizer settings
create_roberta_token_level_tensorizer: create a RoBERTaTokenLevelTensorizer for NER or POS tasks with label columns and label space
numberize_tokens_and_labels: numberize raw tokens and labels into sub-word level IDs with BOS and EOS wrapping
tensorize_batch_with_pad_mask: tensorize a batch of numberized data into padded tensors with pad mask and segment labels
torchscriptify_roberta_tensorizer: torchscriptify a RoBERTaTokenLevelTensorizer into a ScriptRoBERTaTensorizer for optimized inference
